title: Delhi: Seven Cities Under the Open Sky
summary: From the ancient citadel to modern avenues, journey across Delhi's seven historic cities and the cosmic stones of Jantar Mantar, returning to the open sky above a living capital.

fields.director_notes: Directed with MiniMax M3.1 Flash (model minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash via SandBase API). Brief: Adapt stone-stars-city to tell the story of Delhi's seven historic cities and the solar instruments of Jantar Mantar from dawn to starlight. Produced using stone-stars-city, MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD English narration, custom architectural geometry, and celestial sun/star choreography.
fields.my_city_line: Delhi: seven cities buried, one life breathing under the stars.
